The '''Assemblage auditorium''' was a chamber within the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] control of the complex. Located off of the [[Grand Corridor]], the chamber was used for debates by the [[New Republic Ruling Council|Ruling Council]], [[Senator/Legends|senators]], [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] and other [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] involved in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government.
